name: sgemm_lora_a
description: Segmented LoRA-A projection. x is [S, K], weights is [num_lora, R, K], and batch_info provides seg_indptr, weight_indices and an optional permutation. For each segment and row in its token range, out[row] = x[row] @ weights[weight_indices[b]].T, with accumulation in float32 and the result cast to x.dtype; rows are gathered through permutation when present. The native implementation stages partial K-splits internally and returns a newly allocated [S, R] tensor, leaving inputs unchanged. stack_num is accepted for SGLang API compatibility but is not used by this implementation. Suites exercise bfloat16 x/weights and int32 batch metadata.
